scenes.title: A Kite Made with Love
scenes.body: A little fox carefully glued bright paper onto wooden sticks. The kite looked a bit lumpy and lopsided, but the fox smiled. When the wind stayed quiet, the kite just flopped on the grass. "That's okay," said the fox. "I'll try again."
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: Run, Run, Jump!
scenes.body: The little fox ran across the meadow, holding the kite high. The kite bounced and dipped, then fell with a soft thud. The robin fluttered down and chirped, "Your kite is still learning, just like you!" The fox laughed and picked the kite up again.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: Stuck in the Branches
scenes.body: A big breeze pulled the kite up—but it caught in a low tree branch. The little fox tugged gently and shook the branch. "I will not give up," the fox said. With one careful pull, the kite slipped free and fluttered down like a happy leaf.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: Up, Up, and Away
scenes.body: The wind blew strong and steady. The kite rose higher and higher, with its tail wiggling like a happy ribbon. The little fox lay back on the soft grass and watched. "We did it," the fox whispered. "Trying again made all the difference."
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about perseverance.
